# Software Factory Control Tower

> Public observability surface for KAFKA2306's autonomous software factory, plus the AGR CLI for reusable Agent Skills.

## Canonical public surfaces

- Control Tower: https://agent-resources-one.vercel.app/
- Documentation: https://agent-resources-one.vercel.app/site/
- Control Tower architecture: https://agent-resources-one.vercel.app/site/control-tower/
- AGR CLI: https://agent-resources-one.vercel.app/site/cli/
- Source: https://github.com/KAFKA2306/agent-resources

## Factory objective

Routine human intervention should trend to zero. Routine CI, provider/model, runner, merge, artifact, deployment, and production-probe failures are repair-loop inputs rather than terminal notifications.

Canonical state remains in owner repositories, GitHub, deployment providers, artifacts, and production evidence. The Control Tower is a cross-repository read model, not a second source of truth.

## AGR install

~~~bash
uv tool install git+https://github.com/KAFKA2306/agent-resources.git
agr add anthropics/skills/frontend-design
agrx anthropics/skills/pdf
agr sync
~~~
